## Para. 3.1

## Scope

## 1.1 This practice direction applies to claims by HM Revenue and Customs for the recovery of—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 1.1 This practice direction applies to claims by HM Revenue and Customs for the recovery of—] (a) Income Tax,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 1.1 This practice direction applies to claims by HM Revenue and Customs for the recovery of—] (b) Corporation Tax,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 1.1 This practice direction applies to claims by HM Revenue and Customs for the recovery of—] (c) Capital Gains Tax,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 1.1 This practice direction applies to claims by HM Revenue and Customs for the recovery of—] (d) Interest, penalties and surcharges on Income Tax, Corporation Tax or Capital Gains Tax which by virtue of section 69 of the Taxes Management Act 1970 are to be treated as if they are taxes due and payable,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 1.1 This practice direction applies to claims by HM Revenue and Customs for the recovery of—] (g) National Insurance Contributions and interest, penalties and surcharges thereon,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 1.1 This practice direction applies to claims by HM Revenue and Customs for the recovery of—] (f) student loan repayments deducted by and recoverable from an employer under Part IV of the Education (Student Loans) (Repayment) Regulations 2000 (S.I. 2000/944),

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 1.1 This practice direction applies to claims by HM Revenue and Customs for the recovery of—] (g) Value added tax and interest and surcharges thereon,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 1.1 This practice direction applies to claims by HM Revenue and Customs for the recovery of—] (h) Insurance premium tax and interest and penalties thereon,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 1.1 This practice direction applies to claims by HM Revenue and Customs for the recovery of—] (i) Stamp duty land tax and interest and penalties thereon,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 1.1 This practice direction applies to claims by HM Revenue and Customs for the recovery of—] (j) the following environmental taxes –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 1.1 This practice direction applies to claims by HM Revenue and Customs for the recovery of—] (i) landfill tax and interest and penalties thereon,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 1.1 This practice direction applies to claims by HM Revenue and Customs for the recovery of—] (ii) aggregates levy and interest and penalties thereon, and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 1.1 This practice direction applies to claims by HM Revenue and Customs for the recovery of—] (iii) climate change levy and interest and penalties thereon,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 1.1 This practice direction applies to claims by HM Revenue and Customs for the recovery of—] (k) the following duties of customs and excise—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 1.1 This practice direction applies to claims by HM Revenue and Customs for the recovery of—] (i) amusement machine licence duty and penalties thereon,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 1.1 This practice direction applies to claims by HM Revenue and Customs for the recovery of—] (ii) air passenger duty and interest and penalties thereon,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 1.1 This practice direction applies to claims by HM Revenue and Customs for the recovery of—] (iii) beer duty and penalties thereon,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 1.1 This practice direction applies to claims by HM Revenue and Customs for the recovery of—] (iv) bingo duty and penalties thereon,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 1.1 This practice direction applies to claims by HM Revenue and Customs for the recovery of—] (v) cider and perry duty,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 1.1 This practice direction applies to claims by HM Revenue and Customs for the recovery of—] (vi) excise and spirits duty,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 1.1 This practice direction applies to claims by HM Revenue and Customs for the recovery of—] (vii) excise wine duty,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 1.1 This practice direction applies to claims by HM Revenue and Customs for the recovery of—] (viii) gaming duty and penalties thereon,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 1.1 This practice direction applies to claims by HM Revenue and Customs for the recovery of—] (ix) general betting duty,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 1.1 This practice direction applies to claims by HM Revenue and Customs for the recovery of—] (x) lottery duty and penalties thereon,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 1.1 This practice direction applies to claims by HM Revenue and Customs for the recovery of—] (xi) REDS (registered excise dealers and shippers) duty,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 1.1 This practice direction applies to claims by HM Revenue and Customs for the recovery of—] (xii) road fuel duty and penalties thereon,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 1.1 This practice direction applies to claims by HM Revenue and Customs for the recovery of—] (xiii) tobacco duty, and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 1.1 This practice direction applies to claims by HM Revenue and Customs for the recovery of—] (xiv) wine and made-wine duty.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 1.1 This practice direction applies to claims by HM Revenue and Customs for the recovery of—] 1.2 This practice direction also applies to claims by the Welsh revenue Authority for the recovery of a devolved tax (as defined by section 116A(4) of the Government of Wales Act 2006) and interest and penalties thereon.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 1.1 This practice direction applies to claims by HM Revenue and Customs for the recovery of—] (Section 116A(4) of the Government of Wales Act 2006 defines a devolved tax as a tax which is specified in Part 4A of that Act as a devolved tax.  For example, section 116L of the 2006 Act specifies as a devolved tax a tax which is charged on a Welsh land transaction and complies with the requirements of that section.)

## Procedure

## 2.1 If a defence is filed, the court will fix a date for the hearing.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 2.1 If a defence is filed, the court will fix a date for the hearing.] 2.2 Part 26 (Case management – preliminary stage) with the exception of rules 26.2 and 26.3, does not apply to claims to which this practice direction applies.

## At the hearing

## 3.1 On the hearing date the court may dispose of the claim.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 3.1 On the hearing date the court may dispose of the claim.] (Section 25A(1) and (2) of the Commissioners for Revenue and Customs Act 2005 (‘the 2005 Act’) provides that a certificate of an officer of Revenue and Customs that, to the best of that officer’s knowledge and belief, a sum payable to the Commissioners under or by virtue of an enactment or by virtue of a contract settlement (within the meaning of section 25(6) of the 2005 Act) has not been paid, is sufficient evidence that the sum mentioned in the certificate is unpaid.)

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 3.1 On the hearing date the court may dispose of the claim.] (Section 168(1) of the Tax Collection and Management (Wales) Act 2016 (“the 2016 Act”) provides that a certificate of Welsh Revenue Authority that a relevant amount (as defined by section 164 of the 2016 Act) has not been paid to Welsh Revenue Authority is sufficient evidence that the sum mentioned in the certificate is unpaid unless the contrary is proved.)

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 3.1 On the hearing date the court may dispose of the claim.] 3.2 But exceptionally, if the court does not dispose of the claim on the hearing date it may give case management directions, which may, if the defendant has filed a defence, include allocating the case.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 49D – CLAIMS FOR THE RECOVERY OF TAXES AND DUTIES > 3.1 On the hearing date the court may dispose of the claim.] Updated: Sunday, 1 October 2023
